producer_report.summary: Added a [landing] table with merge_via_rest = true to athena.toml, placed after [history] and before [records], with a three-line comment giving the reason (squash-only repo, ruleset on main requiring checks, linear history and no force pushes; owner approved merging verified work once required checks pass). That is the only change; git diff shows just those lines. cargo check --locked passes. cargo test --locked FAILS: config::tests::rest_merge_is_off_unless_the_config_turns_it_on (crates/athena-data/src/config.rs:481) asserts athena.toml contains no "[landing]" table, so the new table breaks it. Fixing that means changing a test, which is outside this job's scope (only athena.toml may change), so I did not touch it. The job is not ready to land until that test is updated or the owner widens the scope.

checks_run.note: Workspace builds with the new config; no compile errors.

open_issues: cargo test --locked fails on config::tests::rest_merge_is_off_unless_the_config_turns_it_on (crates/athena-data/src/config.rs:481). Fix: remove or change the assertion at line 481 so it no longer requires athena.toml to lack [landing]. That test edit is outside this job's scope, so it needs the owner or a widened brief.
Tests after athena-data in the run (athena-core, athena-gate, and so on) have not been run because cargo stopped at the first failing crate. Run cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast for a full result.
fmt and clippy were not run; they are not expected to be affected by a TOML-only change.
mistakes: I did not check the test file for a conflict with the new table before editing athena.toml. The test in config.rs:479-487 pins the absence of [landing] in the repo config, so the brief's 'change only athena.toml' scope missed a test that needs a matching change.
learnings: athena.toml is a governance file; config.rs tests load it through REPO_CONFIG.
config.rs test rest_merge_is_off_unless_the_config_turns_it_on asserts that athena.toml has no [landing] table. It must change in the same job that adds the setting.
The setting is read as config.landing.merge_via_rest in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs and used by crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs; it defaults to off.
